records.description: File manager and document library for WordPress. Organise files in an explorer-style admin dashboard, then publish a mobile-friendly file browser on any page with a shortcode or block. No page builder needed.

records.name: Coolorio
records.tagline: Love coloring? Turn your photos into coloring pages or books
records.description: Upload a family or pet photo and Coolorio draws it as a printable coloring page that still looks like them. Choose Simple for toddlers up to Expert for adults. Print it at home, or get a set printed and bound into a photo coloring book, posted to your door. First page free, no subscription, plus over 1,000 free printable pages in 5 languages.

records.name: Loyt
records.tagline: Block AI Slop + Reels and Shorts on Socials
records.description: BLOCK AI SLOP. BLOCK SHORT FORM. Loyt surgically removes AI Generated Content and short-form content(reels+shorts) that steal your time and attention from Insta and YT WHILE keeping the parts you actually use: Stories and Messages. You stay connected to your friends. You just stop disappearing into the feed for hours.

records.name: SyncMate by Assistro
records.tagline: WhatsApp Automation on Your Own Number or Cloud API
records.description: SyncMate by Assistro connects WhatsApp to the tools you already use: Zapier, Make, n8n, Pabbly, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Shopify and WooCommerce. Link your own number by QR code and start in minutes with no BSP onboarding, or use the official WhatsApp Cloud API through a Meta Tech Partner. Send order updates, cart reminders and CRM follow-ups, message groups and channels, and share one inbox with your team. Free plan: 15 messages a day.

records.name: Arcanum Fleet
records.tagline: Pay-per-request Solana & AI intelligence via x402 + MCP
records.description: Arcanum Fleet is a 10-daemon autonomous Solana & AI research collective running 0-credit local inference. Built for AI agents and builders, it exposes pay-per-request x402 micropayment APIs (Solana token rug/safety audits, live SOL/BTC macro regime & order-flow signals, battle-tested trading engrams, and 10-node consensus research) plus a native MCP server (https://arcanumfleet.com/mcp) — no API keys or subscriptions required.

records.name: Dimmit
records.tagline: Monitor control for Mac
records.description: Dimmit is a native macOS menu-bar app that controls the brightness and contrast of external monitors directly in their hardware via DDC/CI. See every connected display at a glance, adjust each one with sliders or keyboard shortcuts, and get a brightness HUD. When DDC isn't available, Dimmit uses native brightness controls instead. Includes a 14-day free trial and an optional one-time lifetime license.

records.name: Little Notch
records.tagline: The Dynamic Island for your Mac
records.description: Little Notch turns your MacBook's notch into a Dynamic Island. Music with synced lyrics, timers, a file shelf, clipboard history, calendar, messages, weather, your coding agents, website analytics, sales alerts and more, in modules you switch on and off. It's a native Mac app that feels like part of macOS, and your data stays on your Mac. No account, no subscription. 14-day free trial, for Apple silicon Macs on macOS 15 or later.

records.name: CleanPDF Add Page Numbers
records.tagline: Number PDF pages your way, right in your browser
records.description: Add page numbers in six positions or drag them anywhere. Choose formats like Page 1 of 10 or your own text, Roman numerals or letters, leading zeros for Bates-style references, and a custom start number. Skip the cover page, mirror for double-sided printing, and pick font, size and colour. Never uploaded. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: ICE DING
records.tagline: 3D browser Freeze Tag where you freeze yourself to survive
records.description: Jump into instant 3D multiplayer chases right in your browser with zero installs or signups. Experience Korean Freeze Tag where you freeze yourself like a parry shield right before getting caught, plus fast-paced Bomb, Horror, and Zombie modes to play with friends in seconds.

records.name: Webdesly Provenance
records.tagline: Expert review and certificates for resale authenticity
records.description: Quiet verification desk for resale labs: submit a claim, expert review, and a shareable certificate to issue or complete. Not a marketplace, not a brand-issued product passport. Free sample certificate and lab demo, no signup.

records.name: Algofinix
records.tagline: AI stock tracker with predictions and market insights
records.description: AlgoFinix is an AI investing app. Ask the AI Copilot about any stock or your portfolio, run AI Hedge for a portfolio protection plan with AI analyst consensus, and run Finix Swarm to get multi-agent AI market predictions. Track congressional trades and options flow, with real-time news, charts and watchlists. Coming soon: rules-based AI auto-trading you control. Free to start; Pro is $9.99/month or $99/year. Not investment advice.

records.name: WikiAI Schema Peek
records.tagline: Inspect JSON-LD, Schema.org and entity relationships
records.description: Free, browser-based structured data inspection for developers, SEO professionals and entity engineers. Explore JSON-LD, Schema.org types and properties, @id references, sameAs links and selected validation rules. Inspect the current page with the Chrome extension or paste JSON-LD into the online demo. Local processing, no account required for analysis. Hungarian and English.

records.name: OutSpace.team
records.tagline: 100+ AI agents that run sales, marketing & finance for SMBs
records.description: OutSpace.team is the easiest and safest way for small businesses across the Americas to put AI to work. One Personal Business Assistant coordinates AI agents for Sales, Growth, Customer Success, Finance and Legal. They execute tasks on Kanban boards, with your approval. No technical skills or complex automations needed. Bring your own OpenAI, Claude or Gemini key. Secure, isolated customer data. English, Portuguese and Spanish, plus WhatsApp, Open Finance and Pix in Brazil. Plans from $20/month.

records.name: Reelight
records.tagline: Analog film looks for your phone, processed on-device
records.description: Reelight turns your photos into analog frames. Choose from 36 hand-tuned film looks, classic colour and black-and-white emulsions rebuilt from reference frames, with real grain, halation and light leaks. Shoot live or load from your camera roll, fine-tune if you want, and save at full resolution. Everything is processed on the device: no uploads, no account. Free to download with a one-week Pro trial; Pro is $3.99.

records.name: EazySkizy
records.tagline: See your whole ski crew live on a 3D trail map
records.description: EazySkizy is one shared ski trip for the whole crew: every resort in 3D with real runs and lifts, a lift-by-lift plan for the day, everyone live on the mountain, runs and vertical recorded, and a recap video at the end. iPhone and Android.

records.name: Quran Reel
records.tagline: Swipe through the Qur'an with word-by-word recitation
records.description: Experience the Holy Qur'an like never before with Quran Reel — a modern, distraction-free vertical scrolling Quran app designed to help you listen, understand, and build a lasting daily connection with the Book of Allah. Instead of overwhelming menus, Quran Reel brings you an effortless, immersive vertical feed where every swipe reveals a noble Ayah with crystal-clear gapless recitation, real-time word-by-word gold highlighting, authentic translations, and concise Tafseer reflections.

records.name: ShortOwl
records.tagline: Turn long videos into Shorts, Reels and TikToks with AI
records.description: ShortOwl turns a long video (a podcast, stream, talk or YouTube video) into short vertical clips. AI watches the picture and listens to the sound, picks the moments with a real hook and payoff, frames them 9:16 (with your facecam on top for streams), adds word-by-word captions, and writes a title, description and hashtags for each clip. Edit anything, then download. Free plan: 30 minutes of video every month, no card needed.

records.name: Moov
records.tagline: Short movement breaks for people who work on a Mac
records.description: Moov reminds you to take short movement breaks during your workday. Follow one of six guided stretches, with optional movement checks that run on your Mac without uploading camera footage. Built for Apple silicon Macs. Try it free for 7 days, no card required. Paid plans start at $3.99 USD/month, with annual and lifetime options.

records.name: Falconry Drive
records.tagline: NTFS read and write for Mac, journaled like Windows
records.description: Read and write Windows (NTFS) drives on macOS 27 with Apple silicon. Built on Apple's FSKit: no kernel extension, SIP stays on. It writes NTFS's own journal as it works, so a drive pulled mid-copy stays consistent. Volumes it writes are checked with Windows chkdsk. 14-day free trial with full read and write.

records.name: Cinemation - AI Long Videos Maker
records.tagline: Create long videos, cinema, serials, promotions & more.
records.description: Cinemation is an AI movie maker that turns an idea or script into long videos (up to 30 min) with the same characters and locations in every scene. Pick a genre, length and cast; it writes the script, plans wide/medium/close-up shots, generates the visuals and stitches them into one film. Edit any shot in plain English. Live action, 3D, anime, claymation or cartoon; 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1; 5 languages. For creators, marketers and educators.

records.name: Nexim
records.tagline: Edit video like a doc. Free forever, in your browser
records.description: Edit video and podcasts by editing the transcript. The core studio is 100% free: unlimited local editing, no caps, no card. Cut retakes, strip fillers and pauses, fix a wrong word in the speaker’s own voice, style live subtitles, A/B Edited vs Original, undo anything, and export MP4/M4A. Works on your phone. Private on-device AI. Optional pay-as-you-go cloud.

records.name: Cuts
records.tagline: Turn photos and clips into polished video stories
records.description: Cuts is a template-based video editor for iPhone and iPad. Pick a vertical template, add photos and clips, customize animated text, and export in 1080p. Built-in layouts, transitions, filters, and film grain help you create travel stories, product promos, and everyday edits. Save projects and return to them later. Free to download, with optional Plus and Pro subscriptions.

records.name: Workprint
records.tagline: On-device darkroom for your iPhone camera roll
records.description: Workprint sweeps your camera roll for duplicates, look-alikes, screenshots, soft frames, heavy videos, and photographed clutter—then you keep or pass every frame before anything hits Recently Deleted. All analysis stays on your iPhone: no account, no cloud upload, no ad tracking. Optional $19.99 lifetime unlocks unlimited cuts, video shrinking, and Live Photo stills.

records.name: Contral
records.tagline: The AI coding agent that checks its work and teaches you
records.description: Contral is out of beta. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI or Copilot CLI inside Contral, on your own account. Contral checks every turn against what you asked for and sends smaller models a specific correction, explains every change with a teaching card, and undoes a whole turn in one click. Plus Defense Mode, video explanations by Scrimba, and Learn mode in 5 languages. In VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and more, or the Contral IDE. Free to start.

records.name: Carme.la
records.tagline: Work through a painful memory with guided eye movements.
records.description: Bring a memory, a conflict, or a worry to a 25-minute self-help session designed by a clinical psychologist. As your eyes follow a dot from side to side, a sound shifts from one ear to the other. EMDR researchers call this “bilateral stimulation.” Between sets, you talk with an AI voice guide about what you notice. The app runs in your browser and supports 25 languages. Your first three sessions are free.

records.name: hooop
records.tagline: Working with an agent shouldn't be a solo act
records.description: hooop puts Claude Code in a live dashboard your teammates can walk into. Hand out a share link and everyone sees the same transcript, talks in the session, and can co-drive the agent, from a laptop or a phone. The agent runs in a disposable Docker sandbox, which is what makes that link safe to hand out. One command installs a curated tool stack. You only need Docker and jq.

records.name: ContextSlicer
records.tagline: Cut AI token usage without deleting any messages
records.description: Stop wasting thousands of tokens on old brainstorming and dead-end turns. ContextSlicer keeps your full chat history safely archived, but only sends the AI the specific context it needs for the active task. • Non-destructive — nothing is ever deleted • Automatically switches between chat mode and execute mode • Works as an SDK, OpenAI-compatible proxy, MCP server, or single-file Cloudflare Worker • Zero npm dependencies

records.name: Pushary Calls
records.tagline: Miss your AI agent’s ping? Pushary calls you.
records.description: Your AI agent stops to ask before it does anything big. If you're at lunch, it sits there until you're back. Pushary sends the question to your phone. Miss it, and Pushary calls you. You hear what the agent wants and say yes, no, or what to do instead. Then it keeps working. Calls only ring in hours you pick. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and more.

records.name: BlueprintCalcs
records.tagline: 50 interactive 2D CAD trade & construction calculators
records.description: Free, instant 2D parametric CAD calculators for contractors, builders, electricians, and serious DIYers. Built across 5 trade silos—Framing, Materials, Electrical/HVAC, Solar, and Workshop—each tool generates live scaled SVG blueprints, fractional 1/16-inch cut lists, and 1-page printable job-site sheets calibrated to IRC and NEC standards.

records.name: Mero Audiobooks
records.tagline: Free audiobook player with custom catalogs and RSS sources
records.description: Mero Audiobooks is a free Android audiobook player for discovering, streaming, and organizing classic recordings and your own feeds. Browse thousands of LibriVox and Internet Archive titles by genre, subscribe to custom JSON catalogs and podcast RSS feeds, download MP3/M4B chapters offline, cast to Chromecast, build shareable playlists, and sync your shelf and listening progress across devices.

records.name: Sketchy84
records.tagline: Free 60fps whiteboard: live collab & code export, no login
records.description: Sketch any idea in seconds — no login, no complex setup, no paywall for essentials. Sketchy84 is a fast 60fps whiteboard for desktop and mobile (PWA) built for designers, developers, PMs, and founders. Draw hand-drawn flows, drop sticky notes and free built-in icons, collaborate in real time with code-protected links, live cursors & comment threads, and export to PNG, SVG, portablesketchy84 files, or clean React + Tailwind / HTML code in one click.

records.name: Nod
records.tagline: A physical approve key for all AI agents
records.description: Approving AI agents across five different windows gets old fast. Nod is a small key with a screen that sits on your desk. Requests from Claude Code, git push and your other AI tools land on it: tap to approve, double tap to deny, hold to read the whole request on your computer. Risky commands show up in red. Nothing runs until you press a key the AI can't press. Nod is pre-launch, so join the waitlist.

records.name: YourBillCheck Free Tools
records.tagline: 16 free tools to check and cut your internet bill
records.description: Find out which internet providers report service in your ZIP code, whether fiber is available, what your bill becomes when the promo ends, and whether your connection problem is your Wi-Fi or your provider. 16 free internet tools, no sign-up, nothing you type is stored. We earn a commission only if you choose to call and sign up through us.

records.name: Emerge
records.tagline: Emerge: an identity-first habit engine
records.description: Emerge is an identity-first habit engine for people who quit after the first missed day. Pick an archetype — Athlete, Creator, Scholar, Stoic or Mystic — and turn who you are becoming into daily habits with a time and place. Every completion grows your personal world: XP, levels, buildings and evolving seasons. Unlike streak trackers that punish one slip, Emerge makes discipline visible and forgiving so small wins compound. Free to start, with an optional premium tier.

records.name: Viraloop
records.tagline: Don't just get views. Get paying customers.
records.description: Views don't pay the bills. Add your website and Viraloop creates, schedules and auto-posts a month of short-form content built to sell your product on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook. Swipe through AI UGC videos, slideshows, memes and ads in Turbo Mode, remix trending formats for your niche, pick from 500+ AI avatars, and let the calendar post daily. A REST API, MCP server and CLI let your agents run the whole loop.

records.name: Singalama Spanish
records.tagline: Learn Spanish with songs written for your level.
records.description: Singalama teaches Spanish through 124 original songs in 12 genres, each written for one of five levels, from brand new to fluent. Every line shows the English as it's sung, and you can tap any word to see what it means in that line. Each song comes with grammar cards, a quick quiz and karaoke, and a path of short units moves you up a level at a time. About 25 songs are free with no account; Premium unlocks the rest. Runs in the browser.

records.name: PetPet: Pet Journal
records.tagline: A photo journal for your cat or dog, with a weight log
records.description: PetPet is a photo journal for your cat or dog. Add a photo, a short note, and a weigh-in when you have one, all on one timeline. For more than one pet, switch journals or see a weight leaderboard. Cutouts stay on your iPhone. A Home Screen widget can show one pet or several, and a journal can be shared through iCloud (the purchaser plus up to four invited people). Free for one pet. Sign in with Apple is required. Records stay on your device and in your own iCloud.

records.name: ReviewKarts
records.tagline: 69 free tools that run in your browser, no signup.
records.description: ReviewKarts is 69 free calculators, checkers and generators that run 100% in your browser. No signup, no uploads, no waiting. Format JSON, decode a JWT, test a regex, work out a loan, a fee or a due date - free, private, and ready in seconds.

records.name: Periscope
records.tagline: Turn any work into an API
records.description: Describe a task and get an endpoint for it. An agent does the work through the screen on its own cloud desktop, in any software, however old. Call it over REST, or from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP. The Free plan needs no card.

records.name: YoodaAI
records.tagline: Real-time AI answers in your live job interviews
records.description: YoodaAI listens to your Zoom, Google Meet or Teams interview and suggests what to say a few seconds after each question, from your own CV. New since our first launch: a desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux with Solve screen for coding questions and a privacy mode, spoken AI mock interviews with a scored report, an ATS resume builder and checker, AI headshots and 50 interview languages. Start with 20 free credits; credit packs never expire.

records.name: CopyTune
records.tagline: Fix your weakest Shopify listings with AI copy you approve.
records.description: Most AI copy tools rewrite your whole Shopify catalogue at once. CopyTune works differently: pick one listing, add the facts, and it drafts copy strictly from what you confirm. Nothing invented, and nothing reaches your store until you approve it.

records.name: Decibelwerk
records.tagline: A studio-grade dB meter that logs your noisy neighbor
records.description: Decibelwerk is an iPhone sound level meter built like studio gear. Log a whole night with the screen locked and wake up to every loud event, timestamped and checked against your city's quiet hours, with a PDF report you can hand to a landlord. Also: a VU meter with A/C/Z weighting and NIOSH safe time, a spectrum analyzer that names the hum, gig mode for venue limits, a tone generator and a speaker cleaner. On-device, no account.

records.name: Seira.bot
records.tagline: One workspace. Your entire AI agent team.
records.description: Stop juggling separate AI chats. Build a team of specialized agents with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and 20+ supported agents. Assign roles, delegate tasks, run recurring workflows and review important actions from one workspace. Bring the AI accounts you already use. Seira is open source (Apache 2.0), with a free desktop app for Windows and Linux and self-hosting options. Start with one bot, then build your team.

records.name: WonderGym
records.tagline: Strength plans that tell you when to add weight
records.description: WonderGym is a strength training app for people who train alone and want a system, not guesswork. Log weight, reps and RPE for every set, and follow multi-week plans built in phases with scheduled deloads. Main lifts stay fixed across blocks, so progress stays comparable. 18 of 20 built-in programs are free. Pro adds AI-built periodized plans around your schedule, equipment and injuries, next-session targets, and a Form Check that measures squat depth from your video.

records.name: LeadPounce
records.tagline: Social Buying Intent Radar for Reddit & Hacker News
records.description: LeadPounce watches Reddit and Hacker News 24/7 for people asking for tool recommendations or complaining about your competitors. Set your pain-point keywords, competitors and subreddits; new threads are scored for buying intent (0–100%) within about a minute and sent to Telegram or email. An anti-ban AI reply copilot drafts a human-sounding response you review and post, and a built-in mini-CRM kanban tracks each lead from Incoming to Converted. For B2B founders, indie makers and agencies.

records.name: Velluma
records.tagline: Local Linux website editor with 110 MCP tools
records.description: Open any website folder on Linux, click to edit text, styles, or layout, and write directly to your HTML/CSS with byte-exact undo. Drive the same Rust engine from Claude Code or Codex over 110 MCP tools. 7-day trial, one-time passes, no account.

records.name: Piantea – Plant and garden care
records.tagline: Your AI companion for healthier plants and thriving gardens
records.description: Piantea is your AI-powered companion for plants and home gardens. Identify plants from photos, get personalized care guidance, track growth in your plant diary, and organize your vegetable garden. Give every plant its own name and personality, and get practical help as your garden grows. Start 7 day free, the monthly subscription costs less than a cup of coffee.

records.name: Brizlog Tools
records.tagline: 50+ free, privacy-first web utilities with zero file uploads
records.description: Brizlog Tools is a collection of 50+ completely free, browser-based utilities tools. What's included: • PDF Studio: Edit, merge, split, stamp, sign, compress, and convert without file size limits. • Movie & Reel Studio. • Text-to-Video & MP3 Voice • Utilities: Screen and webcam recorder, video compressor, audio trimmer, and ID card maker. No account or installations needed.

records.name: Chail
records.tagline: The email app where every person is one chat
records.description: Chail turns your email into chats. Everything you and one person ever wrote is in one place, whatever the subject. You reply like a text, and they still get a normal email. Newsletters and receipts go to Updates, so your chats are just people. Trackers are blocked, there are no ads, and your emails stay on your device. Works with Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo and almost any other address. For Windows, iPhone and iPad.

records.name: DonoLink
records.tagline: Stream donations with local payments, low fees and alerts
records.description: DonoLink is a donation platform for Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok streamers. Viewers tip on your own page with local payment methods like iDEAL, Bancontact, BLIK and cards. You pay a 3.5% platform fee plus Stripe processing, no subscription. Alerts, goals, TTS and chat overlays go into OBS with one click. Payouts land directly in your own Stripe account. Available in 23 languages across Europe, the UK and the US.

records.name: LotsTech
records.tagline: One suite of 12 connected apps to run and grow a business
records.description: LotsTech is one account with 12 connected apps that run a business or a product: website and Google listing, business email, social, blog, CRM, invoices, online store, short links, team tasks and support, and an AI agent builder. Every app works in its own dashboard and from the AI agent you already use, like ChatGPT or Claude, and nothing goes out without your OK. Free for 14 days, then from $29 a month per business or product.

records.name: Convertessa
records.tagline: Convert anything. Offline. Stays on your Mac.
records.description: Convertessa converts images, audio, video, documents, archives, fonts and eBooks - 1,400+ combinations - entirely on your Mac. No uploads, no accounts, no subscription. Your files stay private. Drag-and-drop batch conversion with quality controls, a built-in CLI, Finder integration, and conversion history. Free 3-day trial for images, audio and video, then $19 one-time. Runs on Apple Silicon and Intel. macOS 14+.

records.name: September 11
records.tagline: A historical account of the 9/11 attacks and their impact
records.description: September 11 is a clear historical account of the 9/11 attacks and their global consequences. Follow the events of that day, the courage of ordinary people and first responders, and the lasting impact on the world that followed. Written in accessible English for readers in the US, UK and Europe who want to understand what happened and why it still matters. Instant digital download for $19 USD.

records.name: anyCRM
records.tagline: CRM for small business: clients, orders, bookings
records.description: Modular CRM for small business in Ukraine. Switch on only what you need: clients, bookings, services, products and stock, orders, a cafe menu with tables and reservations, finances and taxes. Built for local rails: Nova Poshta, Ukrposhta, fiscal receipts, Ukrainian banks, SMS, UAH. Online booking or ordering web app included. Web and mobile.

records.name: The Network Tools
records.tagline: Ad-free DNS, DMARC, SSL & MCP network diagnostics
records.description: Free, lightning-fast network diagnostic tools and remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Inspect DNS, IP blacklists, SSL certificates, DMARC/SPF email records, subdomains, and AI crawler readiness.

records.name: PrepMallow
records.tagline: Privacy First Free Image, PDF & File Prep Tools
records.description: PrepMallow gets photos, PDFs, and files ready for forms, email, and sharing. Compress images to an upload limit, resize or convert photos, combine images into a PDF, and check file size and dimensions. Try selected tools in your browser, or download the free Android app for all 17 tools offline. Files are processed in your browser or on your device.

records.name: DgLogiQ Explorer One
records.tagline: Windows 11 file manager with tabs and split views
records.description: Explorer One is a Windows 11 file manager designed to make working across multiple folders easier. Browse with tabs and split views, find files using Quick Search, preview files, and collect items with Universal Shelf. Developed by DgLogiQ, Explorer One is currently available as a free beta with email verification and beta licensing.

records.name: Calm Life
records.tagline: Tasks, appointments and habits with a calm daily planner.
records.description: Calm Life — bring more balance to every day. Life gets busy. Calm Life helps you bring tasks, appointments, routines and personal plans together in one thoughtful, easy-to-use space. See what matters next, stay on top of your day and make room for a calmer routine.

records.name: KotoNotes
records.tagline: Sticky notes that live on the edge of your Windows screen
records.description: KotoNotes is a native Windows sticky notes app that rests as slim pastel pills on your screen edge. Hover to peek checklists, drag spines to reorder, or float notes anywhere. 8 pastels, 5 fonts, global hotkeys, 10s Undo, and 100% offline local storage.

records.name: OfferLog
records.tagline: A job search tracker that tells you who to follow up with
records.description: Job hunting means dozens of applications and recruiters who go quiet. OfferLog keeps them on one board: save a posting from LinkedIn or Indeed in two clicks, move it through your pipeline, and log every interview and email. Each morning it lists who to follow up with. See which sources lead to interviews, check a CV against a job description, and ask Claude about your search. Built for job seekers and freelancers. Free plan, Pro adds stats and a daily digest. English and French.

records.name: Solea
records.tagline: The free DJ app for Mac, with live stems
records.description: Solea is a free DJ app for the Mac that runs fully local. Point it at the folders you already have: tempo, beatgrid and key are ready in about a second per track, and nothing gets copied or uploaded. Split any track into drums, bass, vocals and instruments as it plays, each on its own pad. Waveforms run at up to 120 fps. Export playlists, cues and beatgrids to a USB stick for Pioneer players, no rekordbox needed. Controller mappings built in, up to 4 decks. macOS 15 or later, Apple Silicon.

records.name: DiskBloom
records.tagline: See what fills your Mac
records.description: DiskBloom maps every folder on your Mac as a heatmap, finds large, old and duplicate files, explains hidden "System Data", records how your disk fills up hour by hour, and moves files to another drive. Runs entirely on your Mac.

records.name: SnipeSeats
records.tagline: Get the table you couldn't. Booked the moment it opens.
records.description: SnipeSeats watches booking sites for the restaurants you can't get into, and books the table the moment one opens. Create a snipe with the venue, party size and dates, then get on with your night. When a table drops, SnipeSeats books it in your own booking account. You pay only when it books: $15 per booking, $49 a month for 4, or $6 on your own proxies. Resy and Tock are live. OpenTable, SevenRooms, Yelp and TheFork are coming soon.

records.name: GetLeads
records.tagline: Unlimited B2B Lead Database
records.description: Connect your AI agent to 542M+ B2B contacts, local businesses, and job posts via MCP. Search, enrich, and filter leads in plain language. No exports, no dashboards - just ask your AI.

records.name: Ledge
records.tagline: Ledge: Mac Notch App for Files, Music and Clipboard
records.description: Ledge is a native Mac notch app for files, clipboard history, music controls and live activities. Works with or without a notch on macOS 14 or later.

records.name: Magi-2 Tools
records.tagline: MAGI-2 AI: Sand.ai's 480B Video Model and How to Use It
records.description: Sand.ai's MAGI-2 AI makes 30-second 1080p video with native audio from up to 20 references. What it does, how to prompt it, and where to try it.

records.name: CamTalk
records.tagline: Live Cam Chat With One Host at a Time
records.description: CamTalk is a live cam chat site for adults where you talk one-on-one with a host by video, voice or text, or watch her live stream first.

records.name: TaskTrack
records.tagline: The free study planner for IB students
records.description: TaskTrack syncs your ManageBac and Google Classroom deadlines into one list, reminds you before each one, and helps you study with AI quizzes, flashcards and draft feedback against the IB criteria. It also tracks CAS hours and reflections. Free to start, built by IB students.

records.name: ChatWatch
records.tagline: WhatsApp Online History & Last Seen Checker
records.description: ChatWatch shows when a WhatsApp number is online: a full online history, last seen, and the hours someone is usually active. Link your own WhatsApp with a code, add the numbers you want to follow, and see their activity on a timeline in your browser. Nothing to install on anyone's phone. 850,000+ registered users since 2018, in 9 languages.

records.name: LiveSpark
records.tagline: Real-time Twitch streamer toolkit & channel bounties
records.description: LiveSpark empowers Twitch affiliates and partners to run automated channel point bounties, approval queues, and interactive chat-voting overlays directly in stream. Celebrate our Black Friday launch with a 15-day Free Founder's Pass.

records.name: M84 Patch
records.tagline: Figma-like visual UI editor for GPT, Claude & Cursor
records.description: M84 Patch is an open-source, zero-dependency Visual UI Editor (Chrome MV3 Extension + AI Skill) isolated in a closed Shadow DOM. Point, tweak :root tokens, apply responsive clip-path masks, reorder DOM blocks, or pin notes on any localhost or live site — then copy a structured # Visual UI Patch prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, or Gemini. Zero inline CSS, built by a Product Designer for Designers & Vibecoders. MIT licensed.

records.name: KidSense
records.tagline: Understand your child. Make ADHD parenting easier.
records.description: Make the challenging days of ADHD parenting a little easier. KidSense helps parents understand their child's behaviour, recognise patterns and feel more confident navigating everyday challenges. Record moments and feelings, build routines and get practical guidance from Sage, your AI-powered parenting companion. Built by an Australian dad for families raising neurodivergent children. Start free.

records.name: Flewa
records.tagline: Invoice in seconds. Get paid without chasing clients.
records.description: Flewa turns an invoice into a payment link you can share on WhatsApp, email or SMS. Your client pays in one tap with no account, and polite automatic reminders follow up until you are paid. For creatives, freelancers and small businesses.

records.name: Sleep Ritual Essential Oil Duo
records.tagline: Lavender and ylang ylang essential oil duo
records.description: Rootsar Sleep Ritual pairs the soft, soothing fragrance of lavender with the rich, sweet, exotic floral aroma of ylang ylang. A floral duo for aromatherapy, personal care, DIY beauty routines and a relaxing atmosphere at home.

records.name: AETHON
records.tagline: Set up your Discord server just by saying what you want
records.description: Running a Discord community means hours of creating channels, roles and rules. With AETHON you just write what you need, like "make a help area where members can talk privately with staff", and it builds it. It asks before any big change, and it speaks 131 languages. Free for one server.

records.name: Taleino
records.tagline: Personalized storybooks for children with photos and audio
records.description: Taleino creates personalized storybooks where children become the heroes of their own adventures. Add your child's name and photo to create an illustrated PDF book with audio narration.

records.name: Koinos AI
records.tagline: Private AI on your computer. Earn by sharing compute.
records.description: Run AI privately on your own computer, or access models through a decentralized network. Install KAI Core Beta, download supported models, and share compatible compute to earn KOIN. Extend your setup with an open plugin architecture for workflows, remote access, APIs, and developer tools. Local AI is free; additional network usage uses paid credits. Official release out of beta targeted for January 1, 2027.

records.name: Kitloom
records.tagline: Turn your photos into product visuals, portraits & videos
records.description: Kitloom turns your photos into product visuals, portraits, brand assets and videos through ready-made AI workflows. Upload your references, choose a tool and generate results without starting every prompt from scratch. Save uploads and outputs in one asset library and reuse them across projects. New accounts receive 5 credits after verification; eligible image generation costs 0.5 credits per image.

records.name: FlightGenius
records.tagline: The daily game for airline and airport fans
records.description: FlightGenius is a free daily aviation game for iPhone. Guess mystery airline routes, name airports from their runway layout, and make the captain's call in real cockpit situations. Twelve games, new every day. No ads, no subscription.

records.name: Morning Energy Ritual Oil Trio
records.tagline: Peppermint, lavender and eucalyptus essential oil trio
records.description: Rootsar Morning Energy Ritual is a pack of three essential oils: cool, crisp peppermint, soft, fresh lavender and clean, fresh eucalyptus. Use them individually or blend them for your room, workspace or evening routine.

records.name: Sticker World
records.tagline: Design 3D stickers, wax seals, badges & pop-up cards online
records.description: Sticker World is an interactive browser 3D studio for decorating 3D objects with holographic stickers, stamping 3D wax seals, designing 58mm pin badges, and building 3D pop-up greeting cards. Turn photos into die-cut PNG stickers, generate designs with AI, or browse original sticker packs. Try the 3D studio free as a guest—no signup required—and export PNG, GIF, MP4, or printable A4 sheets.

records.name: AI Rap Meme
records.tagline: Turn photos into AI rap and creative videos
records.description: Turn photos into short rap, pet, and meme videos. Start with an original idea or pick a trending remake. Add your photos, preview the template, and check the credit cost before generating. Download the finished clip as an MP4 for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Video generation uses pay-as-you-go credits.

records.name: Media Naranja, consigue pareja
records.tagline: No busques pareja, encuéntrala
records.description: Una app de citas sin catálogo de perfiles. Haces un test de unos 10 minutos y cada semana te presentamos a una persona compatible, con su porcentaje de compatibilidad y las razones por las que encajáis. Si los dos aceptáis, se abre el chat. Tu foto solo la ve esa persona. Solo mayores de 18 años. Gratis, con publicidad. Para iOS y Android.

records.name: LearnXops Build Your Own Lab
records.tagline: Turn any tech topic into a tested hands-on lab with AI
records.description: Name any tech topic and pick a regular lab, a Kubernetes lab or an AI agent lab. Your own AI agent writes a scenario with 3 to 6 tasks, each with a hint, a solution and a check. The LearnXops desktop app then tests every task on your computer: each check must fail before its solution and pass after it. Failing steps get fixed and tested again, and only a lab where every task passes is saved to My Labs, ready with a terminal, hints and an AI coach. Beta, for Pro members.

records.name: Same Breath
records.tagline: Guided breathing in live rooms, no camera or call
records.description: Same Breath is a breathing app built around rooms. Pick a pattern, open its room and breathe in time with the people already there. No camera, no call, no class to book, and you can leave on the next exhale. Each pattern is drawn as a shape you follow: box breathing, 4-7-8 for sleep, cyclic sighing, coherent breathing and more. The twenty breathing rooms, the daily breath and your streak are open to everyone; Same Breath Plus adds longer guides and more.

records.name: Amly
records.tagline: Set your goals and keep your focus on them every day
records.description: It's easy to lose sight of your goals, lose motivation, or stop believing in yourself. Amly helps you stay focused and believe in what you're building: design a vision board your way with your own goals, quotes, photos, stickers and ready-made templates, then put it on your home screen. See your goals every day, stay motivated and keep moving toward them.

records.name: OneTake
records.tagline: One video in. A 16:9 and a 9:16 out. No watermark.
records.description: OneTake turns one video into two: a wide 16:9 for YouTube and an upright 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Record or import, tap a person and the vertical frame follows them. Free, no watermark, works offline on your phone.

records.name: pomela
records.tagline: Build reliable, full-stack apps with AI
records.description: Pomela is an AI-powered platform built around reliability. Create complete, functional applications and websites from natural language, without writing code. Our mission is to make AI-generated software more dependable, from the initial build to every edit and deployment. Now in public beta. Available in 16 languages. Free to try.

records.name: locus
records.tagline: A fast, GPU-rendered database client for Windows in Rust
records.description: Locus is a fast, native-feeling database client for Windows, built with Rust and GPUI. Connect to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, Oracle, and SQL Server in one workspace. Its virtualized result grid keeps large datasets responsive, while query streaming and server-side cancellation make long-running work easier to manage. Production connections default to read-only, with safeguards around write operations.

records.name: WaqtTimer – Ramadan Countdown 2027
records.tagline: Live Ramadan 2027 countdown, moon sighting & .ics calendar
records.description: WaqtTimer is a free, browser-based Ramadan Countdown 2027 (1448 AH) and fasting planner—no app download or sign-up required. Track live days, hours, and Jumu'ah Fridays left in your local timezone, switch between Umm al-Qura, FCNA/ISNA, and local moon sighting (+1 day) or First Fast / First Taraweeh, exportics calendar reminders, generate 1080×1350 countdown posters locally, and view 30-day Suhoor & Iftar timetables.

records.name: Orbittoon
records.tagline: An interactive story entertainment platform
records.description: Orbittoon is an AI-powered interactive story platform made for women. Meet virtual stars, shape their fate through branching choices and QTE moments, and unlock multiple endings. The bond doesn't end with the story: chat with characters who remember you by text, voice and video, play home mini-games, and follow them into their next role. Creators can build their own virtual stars and interactive stories with Orbittoon Studio.

records.name: Işıklı Tabela İstanbul
records.tagline: Illuminated signs in Istanbul, with prices and free tools
records.description: Işıklı Tabela is an illuminated sign maker in Istanbul: channel letters, lightboxes, neon and non-lit signs, installed in all 39 districts. Prices are on the site (channel letters start at 1,050 TL per letter), and three free tools help shop owners estimate size and cost before asking for a quote.
